stdout:
Delete channel sections. Use this tool to delete channel sections by IDs.

Usage:
  yutu channelSection delete [flags]

Examples:
# Delete a channel section by ID
yutu channelSection delete --ids abc123
# Delete multiple channel sections
yutu channelSection delete --ids abc123,def456

Flags:
  -h, --help                            help for delete
  -i, --ids strings                     Delete the channel sections with the given ids
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
      --yes                             Confirm the operation
